name: Everlight - See in the Dark
summary: Brightens the light map so you always see clearly - caves, the Nether and the End included. Works with OptiFine or Polytone.
body:
**Everlight - See in the Dark** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It makes the world readable everywhere, and changes nothing else.

### What it does
- Replaces the light map, so low light levels stay bright instead of fading to black
- Caves and the night surface become as readable as a sunlit plain - that is where
  vanilla is genuinely black, and where this pack does the most
- The Nether and the End get a lift as well, but vanilla already lights them
  reasonably well, so the difference there is smaller
- Torch light is perfectly steady - no flicker at all
- Night stays slightly cooler and dimmer than day, so the world keeps a day/night cycle instead of looking permanently noon

### Requirements - pick one
- **OptiFine** (any recent version) - the classic route.
- **Polytone** - a small Fabric/NeoForge mod that adds this feature for players running Sodium and Iris instead.

The light map is not a vanilla asset - Minecraft generates it at runtime - so one of the two is genuinely required. Without either, this pack will do nothing.

### Install
1. Install **OptiFine**, or **Polytone** on Fabric/NeoForge.
2. Download the `.zip` from this page (do not unzip it).
3. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` and enable it in **Options -> Resource Packs**.

Works on Minecraft **1.19 -> 1.21.x** (Java Edition). Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

### Servers
On competitive servers this is a visual advantage, so check the rules before using it.

---

Liked it? You can support the work on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/fliflight).

version.changelog: Initial release: bright light map for all three dimensions, flicker-free torch light, day/night kept readable. Ships light maps for both OptiFine and Polytone.
